questions: What does rx_for_pid return when the PID has no matching channel? The old code's channel_index_for_rx call could fail or return invalid index.
Is there a guarantee that the filter always maps to channel 0? The hardcoded channel access assumes this, but the relationship between filter and channel index isn't clear from this diff.
Are there any mutexes protecting t->poll_pid and t->chans in the worker thread? The diff shows concurrent access patterns without visible synchronization.
What is the full definition of j2534_uri_params? Need to verify the struct is POD and C-compatible for ABI stability.
Where is the resolve_channels function? Need to understand how it populates t->chans and t->chan_count.

claim: Hardcoded channel index 0 breaks poll mode channel selection. The old code correctly found the receive channel for the poll PID using channel_index_for_rx and rx_for_pid, but the new code hard-codes 0, which will use the wrong CAN ID and potentially the wrong channel.; file: core/src/j2534_transport.cpp; quote: build_mode01_request(req, t->chans[0].tx_id, t->poll_pid);

claim: Missing channel validation for poll mode allows dereferencing empty channel array.
